comment: 32yo female, sedentary office worker, habitual SSB intake ~3 servings/day (regular soda + sweetened iced tea + sports drink with workouts) for ~10 years. BMI 28 (overweight) with modest weight gain over 5 years. No personal CRC, no family history. SSB ≥2/day associated with ~RR 2.2 for early-onset CRC per Hur 2021 Nurses' Health Study II analysis. Fires RF-LIFESTYLE-SUGARY-BEVERAGES-PREVENTION (relevant_diseases: CRC, PDAC, endometrial, breast). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-LIFESTYLE-SUGARY-BEVERAGES-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (substitute with water/unsweetened beverages + weight + glycemic monitoring + CRC screening per age-appropriate USPSTF cadence); alternative = IND-LIFESTYLE-SUGARY-BEVERAGES-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (general dietary counseling only).
